Made in small batches, with love

Sunday Best Handmade started with a simple idea: earrings should feel like your Sunday best — the pair you reach for when you want to feel put-together, whether that's church, a classroom, a tailgate, or brunch with friends.

Each design begins as a slab of polymer clay, marbled and patterned by hand, then cut, shaped, baked, sanded, and sealed for durability and lasting color. Because everything is made in small batches, quantities are limited — when a style sells out, it may never come back in quite the same way.

Alongside earrings, the shop also offers greeting cards — because a handmade note deserves a handmade gift to go with it.

  • MaterialsHigh-quality polymer clay, sealed for durability and lasting color
  • HardwareNickel-free & hypoallergenic — made for sensitive ears
  • StylesLeaf, teardrop, geometric, studs & dangles — boho, floral, seasonal & team-spirit designs
  • Perfect forEveryday outfits, gifts for teachers, moms, friends & bridesmaids

Good to know

Are the earrings heavy?
Not at all. Polymer clay is famously lightweight — even the larger statement dangles are comfortable for all-day wear. Most shoppers say they forget they're wearing them.
I have sensitive ears. Can I wear these?
Yes — the shop uses nickel-free, hypoallergenic hardware specifically so sensitive ears can enjoy them too.
Will my pair look exactly like the photo?
Very close, but never identical — and that's the charm. Marbling and hand-finishing mean slight variations from pair to pair. Your pair is genuinely one of a kind.
How fast do orders ship?
Reviewers consistently call out quick, fast shipping. Exact timelines are confirmed at checkout on the live store.
Do you take custom or bulk orders?
The shop welcomes questions about custom colors and gift orders (think bridesmaids, teacher gifts, team colors). Message the shop through Etsy — or ask the assistant below and it will point you the right way.
